industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding
summary: Mogan Enerji Yatirim Holding AS engages in the generation of renewable energy. It operates renewable energy plants such as geothermal, hydroelectric, and wind power plants. The company was founded on January 2, 1980 and is headquartered in Golbasi, Turkey.
